About Progeni

Browser-First Digital Utilities

Fix everyday digital problems privately, instantly, and without subscriptions.

Our Philosophy: Privacy by Design

Most online converters and utility sites force you to upload your sensitive spreadsheets, contacts, personal photos, and calendar files to random remote servers. At Progeni, we believe small consumer tasks should be fast, transparent, and completely private.

All processing in our 30+ utilities occurs directly inside your web browser using HTML5, Canvas, Web Audio, and Web Cryptography APIs. Your files never leave your device.

Who is Progeni Built For?

  • Crafters & Creators: Make sticker sheets, mirror T-shirt prints, create cross-stitch patterns, and test video safe zones for TikTok and Instagram.
  • Professionals & Marketers: Clean exported Chrome bookmarks, split large CSVs, deduplicate contact databases, and format vCards.
  • Everyday Power Users: Convert timetables to iCal, check subtitle reading speed, find duplicate photos, and optimize print layouts.

Open, Fast, and Free

Progeni is engineered for maximum speed with zero bloated JavaScript frameworks or tracking scripts. The entire toolsuite is accessible from any modern desktop or mobile browser.
